sermon.title: Church and Children 09/23/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that the church is accountable to promote Bible marriage and to teach children the whole of life, from hygiene to morals. Believers must be an example in word and conduct, defend the fatherless, expose abuse and neglect, and trust God’s promise that great shall be the peace of the children.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Statistics on fatherless homes, abuse, deaths and trafficking are kept as spoken and were not checked. Contains descriptions of child sexual abuse cases and mentions photos shown in the service (23:20–43:00).

chunks.section_question: What is neglect and physical abuse?

scriptures.text_nkjv: Some indeed preach Christ even from envy and strife, and some also from goodwill: The former preach Christ from selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my chains; but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel. What then? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is preached; and in this I rejoice, yes, and will rejoice.
How then shall they call on Him in whom they have not believed? And how shall they believe in Him of whom they have not heard? And how shall they hear without a preacher?

faqs.question: Should you choose a church for its music?
faqs.answer: No, for truth and Jesus Christ.

faqs.question: Should Christians just give money to the poor?
faqs.answer: He says make people responsible, not just give with emotion.

faqs.question: What does he say about custody courts?
faqs.answer: They automatically give kids to mothers, as if men can’t raise kids.

faqs.question: How many children died of abuse and neglect in 2016, per him?
Whom does he recommend listening to?
Do abused kids know they were wronged?
faqs.answer: Often they think it is normal life.
